method: Read from the live Create screen through the maintainer's signed-in browser session (DOM attributes, screenshots, tooltips). No generation was started.
interfaceVersion: Not shown on the page; models offered were v6, v6-wild, and v6-mini.
notDetermined: Sub-options of the Voice input, and the full flows for Audio, Voice, Inspo, Playlist, Image, and Video inputs (covered by spike TS-002).
Whether Max Mode, Personalize, Custom Models, Voice, and Inspo require a paid plan beyond the Pro badges shown on v6 and v6-wild.
Default model for a new account (the form remembers the last choice).

fields.label: Model version
fields.notes: Dropdown also offers 'Create Custom Model (Beta)', built from the user's uploads for 100 credits; a custom model, once created, is presumably selectable here (not verified). Default not determined: the form remembers the last choice.

fields.label: Song description
fields.notes: Single free-text prompt. Suno enforces no limit in the form; n8Tracks uses 1,000 characters for now (maintainer's decision).

fields.label: Add: Lyrics
fields.condition: Opened from the + menu in the prompt box
fields.notes: Adds a lyrics input to the Simple form.

fields.label: Add: Styles
fields.condition: Opened from the + menu in the prompt box

fields.label: Add: Playlist
fields.notes: Playlist as inspiration; mechanics belong to TS-002.

fields.label: Add: Image
fields.notes: 'Add an image to your creation.' Not offered in Advanced mode.

fields.label: Add: Video
fields.notes: Not offered in Advanced mode.

fields.label: Audio
fields.notes: 'Add audio - Browse, upload, or record audio'. Mechanics belong to TS-002.

fields.label: Voice
fields.notes: 'Add Voice'. Sub-options not determined. Mechanics belong to TS-002.

fields.label: Inspo
fields.notes: 'Add inspiration from a playlist'. Mechanics belong to TS-002.

fields.label: Lyrics
fields.notes: Rich text box; empty means instrumental ('leave this empty for instrumental'). Has undo, redo, new draft, saved lyrics, full-screen editor, and an AI 'Help me write lyrics' cowriter. Suno's limit is 5,000 characters (confirmed by the maintainer).

fields.label: Styles
fields.notes: Free text; suggestion chips append to it; saved style prompts can be loaded; a 'personalize to your taste' toggle rewrites suggestions.

fields.label: Vocal Gender
fields.notes: Neither is selected by default. Tooltip: 'Change the gender of the generated vocals'.

fields.label: Duration
fields.notes: Tooltip: 'Desired song length, 10 seconds to 6 minutes.'

fields.label: Max Mode
fields.notes: Tooltip: 'Uses more compute to maximize consistency throughout the song. Costs 2x credits per song.'

fields.label: Weirdness
fields.notes: Tooltip: 'Turn it up for wild, unexpected results'.

fields.label: Style Influence
fields.notes: Tooltip: 'Turn it up to match your style description'.

fields.label: Variety
fields.notes: A five-step slider (0 to 4). Tooltip at Max: 'Clips may differ significantly from your style input.' Default taken from the untouched Speech form; the Songs form remembers the last value.

fields.label: Personalize (My Taste)
fields.notes: Tooltip: 'Make Variety match your taste'.

fields.label: Song Title
fields.notes: Optional. Suno enforces no limit in the form; n8Tracks uses 100 characters for now (maintainer's decision).

fields.label: Save to...
fields.notes: Workspace the result is saved to; shows the current workspace. Not shown in Simple mode.

fields.label: Speech description
fields.notes: Single free-text prompt. Speech is labelled BETA and has no model dropdown. Suno enforces no limit in the form; n8Tracks uses 1,000 characters for now (maintainer's decision).

fields.label: Tone
fields.notes: 'Describe the delivery: tone, pacing, mood and setting'.

fields.label: Model version
fields.notes: Same dropdown as Songs. Sounds has no Simple/Advanced switch.

fields.label: Sound
fields.notes: 'Describe the sound you want'. Sounds are short samples: effects, loops, and one-shots.

fields.label: BPM
fields.notes: Empty means Auto.

fields.label: Key
fields.notes: Combined with a scale choice.

fields.label: Key scale
fields.condition: A key other than Any is chosen

scope: Songs, Speech, and Sounds are all in scope for V1 (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-03).
